snippet.title: Nothing fits… so you take one more chance 🍀 #shorts
snippet.description:
Neither shape fits your board? Draw one more chance from the deck — and hope it lands 🍀 Fewest empty cells wins.

One More Chance — a block puzzle you play together: pass one phone around, play nearby with no internet, or go online.
Free on iPhone & iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6820129103

The people in this video are AI-generated; the game footage is real.

#puzzlegame #mobilegames #boardgames #brainteaser #indiegame
